## createInFlightTracker() function

Create an in-flight request tracker.

Use this to implement graceful shutdown by waiting for all active requests to complete before closing the server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createInFlightTracker(): InFlightTracker;
```
**Returns:**

[InFlightTracker](./api.inflighttracker.md)

An in-flight request tracker

## Example


```typescript
const tracker = createInFlightTracker();
app.use('*', tracker.middleware());

// During shutdown:
await tracker.waitForDrain(10_000);
```
